parameters.content:
## 🎯 What this workflow does

Every morning it checks your blog's RSS feed → picks up posts from the last 24 hours → asks AI to draft a **LinkedIn**, an **X** and a **Facebook** version of each → saves all drafts to a Google Sheet review queue → emails you that drafts are waiting.

## ✋ Nothing ever auto-posts
That is deliberate. AI drafts, a human approves. You read the draft in the sheet, tweak it, and post it yourself (or hand the sheet to whoever runs your socials). Your accounts never hand posting rights to an automation.

Built by RozContent — free template.

## 🛠️ SETUP — do these before activating

1. **RSS URL:** open `Fetch Blog RSS` and replace `https://your-blog.com/feed/` with your real feed URL (WordPress: yoursite.com/feed — most platforms have one).
2. **OpenAI credential:** create a Header Auth credential — Name: `Authorization`, Value: `Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY` — and select it in the `AI Draft` node. (Or swap that node for your preferred AI provider; the prompt returns JSON with linkedin / x / facebook keys.)
3. **Review sheet:** create a Google Sheet tab named exactly `Review Queue` with headers `Created | Platform | Draft | Source Title | Source URL | Status`, and paste the sheet ID into the Sheets node.
4. **CONFIG node:** set your business name, brand voice, and the email that should be told when drafts are waiting.
5. **Test:** click `Run Manually`'s Execute step after publishing any post in the last 24h — or temporarily widen the window in `Keep Only New Posts`.

## ⚠️ Honest limits of the free version

- **De-duplication is a simple 24-hour window.** If the schedule runs twice inside a post's first 24 hours, you may get a second set of drafts for the same post. The paid build keeps a proper 'already drafted' store.
- **Drafts are drafts.** The AI is told not to invent facts beyond the excerpt, but a human still reads before posting — that review step is the product, not a bug.
- Cost per post is a fraction of a cent on a mini-class model; the prompt node is the only paid call.

assignments.name: config_brand_voice
assignments.value: Friendly, expert, plain English. Specific over clever. No hype words, no hashtag spam.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.7, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are the social media writer for ' + $('CONFIG — Edit Me').first().json.config_business_name + '. Voice: ' + $('CONFIG — Edit Me').first().json.config_brand_voice + ' Always reply with ONLY a JSON object with the keys linkedin, x and facebook.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'A new blog post was published.
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Link: ' + $json.link + '
Excerpt: ' + $json.excerpt + '

Write one promotional post per platform:
- linkedin: professional, 2-3 short paragraphs, end with the link.
- x: under 260 characters, punchy, include the link.
- facebook: conversational, 2 short paragraphs, end with the link.
Do not invent facts, numbers or quotes that are not in the excerpt.' } ] }) }}
